notes.title: Help Us Perfect Escape: Left to Die – Join Our Steam Beta Testing!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Our game [i]Escape: Left to Die[/i] is at the finish line…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358865/61e8b7e82334cf184ceb85bef6d0698a48197dab.jpg[/img]

I wish I could say so, but there are bugs. There are many of them, and releasing a product of poor quality can have a very negative impact on the future of the studio. Here are some examples:

[previewyoutube=9yvBov6HMJA;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=TieRjNd-U4k;full][/previewyoutube]

That's why we decided to conduct beta testing via Steam. This “blind check” will help us get a better picture of the game's condition, identify the weakest elements, and improve the overall quality. We need as much data as possible, so we hope you all will take part in it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358865/2d6b1e1a91ed3bd1afe2b6cd82c607f877941c22.jpg[/img]

[b]Why Beta Testing is Crucial[/b]

Beta testing is an essential phase in game development. It allows us to gather real-world data from players who will experience the game without any prior influence. This feedback is invaluable in identifying bugs that we might have missed during internal testing and understanding how different systems within the game interact under various conditions.

[b]How You Can Help[/b]

Your participation is vital for the success of this beta testing phase. By playing the game and reporting any issues you encounter, you will help us pinpoint the exact areas that need improvement. The beta testing phase will last for two weeks.

[b]Thank You![/b]

We truly appreciate your support and dedication to making Escape: Left to Die the best it can be. Together, we can ensure that the final product is polished, engaging, and bug-free. Let's work together to create something amazing!

notes.title: Devlog #2 - Progress on the game
notes.content:
Hi everybody. We have a small update on “Escape: Left to die.”

Firstly, we started fixing the animations in the game - “The Mutant Dog”. We weren't happy with the overall quality of his movements. Therefore, as soon as we had free time, we immediately focused all our efforts on animation. Looks like it turned out well?

[previewyoutube=aMXQxQ_AQdg;full][/previewyoutube]

The second news is the update of supported languages. Taking into account the geography of our main audience, we localized the game into three languages - English, Russian, Azerbaijani. For now the localization looks like this:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358865/2f168c57987a21391a0a4c6c072fa6962e3e7474.jpg[/img]

And the third, perhaps the most important update - updating the visuals. Since the Escape: Left to die” - a thriller with horror elements, then, in our opinion, VHS tape effect will help us enhance the expected reaction from the player. The update consists not only of a “tape filter”, but also the corresponding interface elements and a death screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43358865/17a1672fcf1022bf6fb3ddac803390a06471dbac.jpg[/img]

That's all for now. Wait for further updates and add our game to your wishlist!

notes.title: Kickstarter campaign
notes.content:
AzDimension team, together with Royal Games, announces the creation of a Kickstarter campaign for the recently announced game - "Escape: Left to Die".

"Escape: Left to Die" is a thriller- platformer  that successfully combines tension, mystery and a sense of adventure. Inspired by such acclaimed masterpieces as Soma and İnside, the project promises to provide players with cutting-edge visuals as well as an immersive atmosphere.

AzDimension has a lot of experience in creating immersive games across a variety of platforms including PC, consoles, virtual reality devices and mobile phones. Meanwhile, Royal Games, a rising star in the industry, is showing great potential in the development of PC and mobile games.

But why  Kickstarter? By supporting projects on Kickstarter, any contributor becomes an integral part of the unique development process. Player support can directly impact the development of the game, thereby improving the visuals, enriching the game mechanics and creating an even more unforgettable gaming experience as a whole. Such solution helps developers to fully focus on creating a dream game without being distracted by financial issues, as well as maintain constant communication with the target audience.

“Escape: Left to Die” planned for release on PC and mobile devices.


Link to Kickstarter page:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/543870047/escape-left-to-die
